About
I am graduate student at the University of British Columbia. My program, Master of Data Science (Computational Linguistics), focuses on industry-forward topics in machine learning, statistics, and computational linguistics. I completed an Honour’s Project during my bachelor’s degree which allowed me to explore computational linguistics and low resource languages in a research setting.
In my graduate studies, I am focusing on the combination of my two undergraduate degrees, with an added focus on data. In the future, I hope to continue to bring a focus of language data into my career.
